user.title: Philips WelcomeEye
user.description: Choose the device family before any connection.

r002_confirm.title: Experimental WelcomeEye R002
r002_confirm.description: A signature compatible with R002 was detected; the hardware model is not confirmed. This entry starts with diagnostics only. Reconfigure it to enter the local password and explicitly enable QV trials. Automatic doorbell detection is unavailable.

reconfigure.title: WelcomeEye R002 — experimental
reconfigure.description: The existing R002 entry and identity are preserved. Enter the local password and verified HTTPS fingerprint, then use Check R002 access before a video trial. HTTPS uses port 443; the discovered QV profile selects TCP media on 34567 without TLS, with QV protocol encryption. Video/audio and output controls are off by default. The opening code is separate from the connection password. Blank secret fields keep existing values. Connect 3 QR import and automatic doorbell detection are unavailable.

data.auth_code: R002 local password (separate from opening code)
data.experimental_video: Enable experimental R002 QV video and audio
data.opening_code: Philips opening code (separate from connection password)
data.clear_credentials: Clear password, opening code and HTTPS fingerprint; disable video and outputs

legacy.title: Philips WelcomeEye
legacy.description: Direct local connection to a WelcomeEye intercom. The default username is admin. For the password, use the one you enter in the WelcomeEye app when opening the gate/portal.

connect3.title: WelcomeEye Connect 3
connect3.description: Choose the media transport. HTTPS is always verified before sending your password. TLS mode checks a separate media certificate; QV TCP 34567 is an explicit video-only experiment. The local password is separate from the opening code and Philips account. A blank secret field keeps its value when reconfiguring.

data_description.opening_code: Only needed for opening controls in TLS mode.
data_description.media_transport: TLS is the default. Experimental QV TCP 34567 is video only, without sound, microphone, strike or gate.
data_description.experimental_video: Sound is available in TLS mode. QV TCP 34567 provides video only.
data_description.experimental_outputs: Available only with TLS media. Opening controls remain disabled in QV TCP 34567 mode.

advanced.name: Advanced options
advanced.description: Ports, optional QR import and manual fingerprints. The configurable media port applies only to TLS; QV TCP uses fixed port 34567 with HTTPS 443. An imported QR retains its existing identity check.

connect3_reconfigure.title: WelcomeEye Connect 3
connect3_reconfigure.description: Choose the media transport. HTTPS is always verified before sending your password. TLS mode checks a separate media certificate; QV TCP 34567 is an explicit video-only experiment. The local password is separate from the opening code and Philips account. A blank secret field keeps its value when reconfiguring.

data_description.opening_code: Only needed for opening controls in TLS mode.
data_description.media_transport: TLS is the default. Experimental QV TCP 34567 is video only, without sound, microphone, strike or gate.
data_description.experimental_video: Sound is available in TLS mode. QV TCP 34567 provides video only.
data_description.experimental_outputs: Available only with TLS media. Opening controls remain disabled in QV TCP 34567 mode.

advanced.name: Advanced options
advanced.description: Ports, optional QR import and manual fingerprints. The configurable media port applies only to TLS; QV TCP uses fixed port 34567 with HTTPS 443. An imported QR retains its existing identity check.

data.clear_credentials: Clear credentials and TLS trust; disable video and openings

v1_cloud_reconfigure.title: WelcomeEye Connect V1 — experimental cloud doorbell
v1_cloud_reconfigure.description: Enable experimental V1 doorbell notifications through Philips and Google notification services. An Internet connection is required; no Philips account is requested. Only the doorbell uses the cloud. Video, audio and opening controls keep using your existing local credentials. Off by default; disable this option here at any time.

connect3_tls_confirm.title: Trust your intercom
connect3_tls_confirm.description: Your WelcomeEye Connect 3 local certificates were detected. Do you trust them for your local connections? This trust on first use (TOFU) does not independently prove the device identity. No credentials have been sent. Cancel if unsure.

certificate_details.name: Advanced certificate details
certificate_details.description: Automatically calculated, read-only fingerprints. The two ports are checked independently; identical fingerprints mean the same certificate. No copying or typing is required.

connect3_tls_changed.title: Certificate or endpoint changed
connect3_tls_changed.description: The device certificate or endpoint changed. Existing fingerprints will be replaced only if you approve these certificates. Do you trust them for your local connections? This trust on first use (TOFU) does not independently prove the device identity. No credentials have been sent. Cancel if unsure.

certificate_details.name: Advanced certificate details
certificate_details.description: Automatically calculated, read-only fingerprints. The two ports are checked independently; identical fingerprints mean the same certificate. No copying or typing is required.

connect3_tcp_confirm.title: Enable experimental TCP video
connect3_tcp_confirm.description: Use experimental QV TCP 34567 video on a trusted local network? Credentials are encrypted using a key retrieved over verified HTTPS, but media has no TLS server authentication or authenticated integrity. It is video only: sound, microphone, strike and gate are unavailable. Hardware operation still needs validation. There is no automatic switch from TLS.

certificate_details.name: Advanced HTTPS certificate details
certificate_details.description: Automatically calculated, read-only HTTPS fingerprint. No media TLS certificate is inspected in TCP mode. No copying or typing is required.

connect3_tcp_tls_confirm.title: Approve HTTPS and experimental TCP video
connect3_tcp_tls_confirm.description: Approve this local HTTPS certificate and use experimental QV TCP 34567 video? Trust on first use (TOFU) does not independently prove the device identity. No credentials have been sent. Credentials will be encrypted using a key retrieved over verified HTTPS, but media has no TLS server authentication or authenticated integrity. Video only: sound, microphone, strike and gate are unavailable. Hardware operation still needs validation. Cancel if unsure.

data.trust: Trust the HTTPS certificate and enable experimental TCP video

certificate_details.description: Automatically calculated, read-only HTTPS fingerprint. No media TLS certificate is inspected in TCP mode. No copying or typing is required.

capture_snapshot.name: Capture snapshot
capture_snapshot.description: Capture a fresh image using the shared media session.

save_to_media.name: Save to Media
save_to_media.description: Save the JPEG in the configured Home Assistant media directory.

r002_probe.name: Probe R002
r002_probe.description: Explicit investigation: one request per type, no retries.

include_header.name: Include response prefix
include_header.description: Administrator only. Up to 12 raw bytes in the response. Review before sharing; script traces may retain them.

include_response.name: Observe short response
include_response.description: Administrator only. Collect up to 64 bytes for at most 3 seconds, then compare provisional 10/12-byte layouts. Includes prefix details. Review before sharing; traces may retain bytes.

r002_check_certificate.name: Check R002 certificate metadata
r002_check_certificate.description: Explicit bounded TLS-only check on port 443. Does not authenticate trust or change entry identity.

r002_discover_qv.name: Observe QV LAN discovery
r002_discover_qv.description: Administrator only. One UDP 5000 broadcast, listen on 5001/5003 for at most 3 seconds. Decode matching QV replies locally. No login or media; a missing reply is inconclusive.

include_details.name: Include decoded metadata
include_details.description: Advertised model, firmware, ports and channels in the response only. No UID or IP; metadata does not prove R002 compatibility. Review before sharing.

include_response.name: Include raw datagrams
include_response.description: Return at most 4 datagrams, 2048 bytes each. Review for identifiers before sharing publicly; HA script traces may retain them.

connect3_discover.name: Discover Connect 3
connect3_discover.description: Administrator: one UDP 5000 discovery, listen on 5001/5003 for 3 seconds, decode locally. Does not confirm model or authentication.

include_details.name: Include metadata
include_details.description: Advertised ports and strings in the response only. Review before sharing; HA traces may retain them.

connect3_check_access.name: Check Connect 3 access
connect3_check_access.description: Administrator only. One HTTPS streamkey read using the configured authCode. An imported QR first requires matching UID/model from one discovery. No key returned, no media opened.

connect3_list_records.name: List Connect 3 picture records
connect3_list_records.description: Administrator: metadata only, at most 4 pages within 12 seconds. No photo download or ring correlation. Monitor local time, maximum 24-hour range.

include_details.name: Include records
include_details.description: Private filenames and dates in the response only. Review before sharing; HA traces may retain them.

connect3_check_certificate.name: Inspect Connect 3 HTTPS certificate
connect3_check_certificate.description: Administrator only. One TLS-only inspection of the configured CGI port, without HTTP or credentials. Never automatically trusts a certificate.

include_details.name: Include SHA256 fingerprint
include_details.description: This action response only. Independently verify before configuring trust. HA traces may retain it.

connect3_check_media_certificate.name: Inspect Connect 3 media certificate
connect3_check_media_certificate.description: Explicit TLS-only inspection of the media port. No stream or credentials. Verify trust independently.

include_details.name: Include SHA256 fingerprint
include_details.description: Current response only; HA traces may retain it.

experimental_version_info.name: Experimental legacy version query
experimental_version_info.description: Administrator only, idle legacy device, one bounded attempt. No output command. Disable its doorbell listener before this optional test.

experimental_additional_camera.name: Experimental additional camera diagnostic
experimental_additional_camera.description: Administrator only, idle legacy device, one bounded attempt. No output command. Disable its doorbell listener before this optional test.

experimental_udt_probe.name: Experimental legacy UDT handshake
experimental_udt_probe.description: Administrator only, idle legacy device, known UDP endpoint and observed missing UDP 1500 discovery. No scan, cloud, login, media or output command.

legacy_discovery_absent.name: UDP 1500 discovery is absent or unusable
legacy_discovery_absent.description: Confirm an observed failure, not an assumption about the transport.

udp_port.name: Established UDP endpoint port
udp_port.description: Use an independently established port for this device; never guess or scan.

connect3_observe_doorbell.name: Observe Connect 3 doorbell during live video
connect3_observe_doorbell.description: Administrator only. Open live video first, start observation, press the physical bell once, then mark. Passive metadata only; stops on timeout or media close. This does not implement standby ring detection.

operation.name: Operation
operation.description: start, mark, status or stop. A marker records your reported press, not a detected ring.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: 30 to 120 seconds, only for start. Default 90.

r002_check_access.name: Check R002 access
r002_check_access.description: Administrator only. Check the QV profile with fresh LAN discovery, then read streamkey over HTTPS on port 443 using the configured local password. No key returned, media opened or output command sent.

r002_check_qv_certificate.name: Inspect R002 QV HTTPS certificate
r002_check_qv_certificate.description: Administrator only. One QV LAN discovery checks the profile, then a bounded TLS inspection uses port 443 without HTTP or credentials. The fingerprint is returned only when explicitly requested. Independently verify it before entering it in Reconfigure; never saved automatically.

include_details.name: Include SHA256 fingerprint
include_details.description: This action response only; HA traces may retain it. Off by default.

r002_observe_doorbell.name: Observe R002 doorbell during live video
r002_observe_doorbell.description: Administrator only. Open R002 QV live video, start observation, press the physical bell once, then mark. Passively observe the existing reader without opening another connection. Counts and relative timing only; stops on timeout or video close. No automatic standby ring detection.

operation.name: Operation
operation.description: start, mark, status or stop. A marker records your reported press, not a detected ring.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: 30 to 120 seconds, only for start. Default 90.

v1_observe_doorbell.name: Test Connect V1 doorbell
v1_observe_doorbell.description: Administrator only. Close HA and Philips players. One experimental control session listens for five minutes, then stops automatically. Its report remains in downloaded diagnostics. No media or output command; ring detection is not yet validated.

operation.name: Operation
operation.description: start, mark, status or stop. Mark records a reported press, not a detected ring.

profile.name: Experimental profile
profile.description: control: 0/3/0. long_connection: SDK stream-7 hypothesis, 0/7/0. Five-second keepalive for both.

duration.name: Listening duration
duration.description: 30 to 300 seconds after authentication. Default 300; no automatic repeat.

confirm.name: Confirm this experimental session
confirm.description: Off by default. Required only to start.

confirm.title: Review TLS trust
confirm.description:
The intercom TLS certificate changed. Connection is blocked before sending credentials. Verify the device, then open Reconfigure to explicitly approve its certificates.
